Class Provider

java.lang.Object
Business.Entities.Provider
public class Provider extends Object
Represents a product provider (supplier) in the system. Each provider has company information, a contact person, and a list of products they offer for sale along with their prices and stock levels.

      public Provider(String providerId, String providerCompanyName, String providerCif, String contactName, String providerPhone, String providerEmail, List<ProductStock> providerProductsForSale)
      Constructs a Provider with all required fields.
      Parameters:
      providerId - the unique provider identifier
      providerCompanyName - the company's trading name
      providerCif - the company's tax identification number (CIF)
      contactName - the name of the contact person at this provider
      providerPhone - the provider's phone number
      providerEmail - the provider's email address
      providerProductsForSale - the list of products this provider sells
